transcript: Speaker A: Sir, ek baat discuss karni thi. [Sir, I wanted to discuss something.] Speaker B: Sir, I wanted to discuss something. Speaker A: Main kaafi time se extra responsibility le raha hoon. [I have been taking on extra responsibilities for a long time.] Speaker B: I have been taking on extra responsibilities. Speaker A: Maine apne targets achieve kiye hain. [I have achieved my targets.] Speaker B: I have achieved my targets. Speaker A: Main apne performance par growth discuss karna chahta hoon. [I want to discuss growth based on my performance.] Speaker B: I would like to discuss growth based on my performance. Speaker A: Kya hum promotion pe baat kar sakte hain? [Can we talk about a promotion?] Speaker B: Can we talk about a promotion? Speaker A: Arre yeh toh bahut aasaan hai! [Oh, this is very easy!] Speaker B: Haan, English seekhna aasaan hi hai. Bas tumhe aise practice karte rehna hai aur do hafte mein tumhari English first-class ho jayegi. [Yes, learning English is easy. You just have to keep practicing like this and in two weeks your English will be first-class.] Speaker A: Yeh main kahaan kar sakta hoon? [Where can I do this?] Speaker B: Tumhe bas SpeakX app download karna hai. Isme mere jaise AI English teacher tumhe bina judgment ke English practice karayenge aur tumhari English farratedar ho jayegi. Jaldi SpeakX download karo aur do hafte mein apni English se sabko impress karo! [You just need to download the SpeakX app. In this, AI English teachers like me will make you practice English without judgment and your English will become fluent. Download SpeakX quickly and impress everyone with your English in two weeks!]
on_screen_text: Office main kaam aane wali English [English useful in the office], SpeakX KEY TO CONFIDENCE, TALK ABOUT ANYTHING, Speak with AI TEACHER
summary: A split-screen ad demonstrates how to translate common Hindi office phrases into professional English. An AI avatar guides a human speaker and promotes the SpeakX app as a judgment-free tool to practice English and gain fluency in two weeks.
